preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 10**9 and 0 <= m <= n for n, m in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the length of the string n is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive, and the number of '1's m is between 0 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) for result in results)
all(0 <= result <= n*(n+1)//2 for result, n in zip(results, [n for n, m in test_cases]))
postconditions.description: Each result is between 0 and n*(n+1)/2 inclusive, where n is the length of the string for the corresponding test case.

postconditions.expression: all(result == m*(2*n - m + 1) for result, n, m in zip(results, [n for n, m in test_cases], [m for n, m in test_cases]))
postconditions.description: Each result is equal to m*(2*n - m + 1), where n is the length of the string and m is the number of '1's for the corresponding test case.
